###### EAFIT and Ecopetrol identify opportunities to strengthen sustainable water management in Colombia

What to do with large volumes of water that are currently discarded and how to turn them into a reserve for the future? That was one of the questions that motivated an interdisciplinary team of researchers from EAFIT to develop, together with Ecopetrol, a pioneering project in Colombia.

[Read more](https://www.eafit.edu.co/noticias/nuestro-impacto/eafit-y-ecopetrol-identifican-oportunidades-para-fortalecer-la-gestion "Read more")

[Education and the future](https://www.eafit.edu.co/taxonomy/term/1836)

###### The call for applications for INTRO 2.0 is now open to promote technology-based business ideas.

[Read more](https://www.eafit.edu.co/noticias/nuestro-impacto/abierta-la-convocatoria-de-intro-20-para-impulsar-ideas-de-negocio-de-base "Read more")

[Institutional](https://www.eafit.edu.co/taxonomy/term/1846)

###### EAFIT is the top university in Antioquia and the second in Colombia in terms of reputation, according to Merco Empresas 2026.

EAFIT is the university with the best corporate reputation in Antioquia and the second in Colombia. This is confirmed by the results of Merco Empresas Colombia 2026, which highlight the institution as the best-positioned university in Antioquia in this ranking and reaffirm, for the second consecutive year, its place among the two higher education institutions with the best corporate reputation in the country.

[Read more](https://www.eafit.edu.co/noticias/nuestro-impacto/eafit-es-la-primera-universidad-de-antioquia-y-la-segunda-de-colombia-en "Read more")
